name: participants_file_scan
description: Scan a video recording for participant observations, tracks, change events and coverage. By default a completed scan is cached in the source’s analysis sidecar. Poll file_job_status_read and fetch the JSON with file_job_result_read.

operation_id.description: A fresh UUID for each distinct file job. Reuse it when retrying the same request in this session.

output.description: Optional absolute path for a new scan JSON file. Pass this file to participant project accept or marker building.

resume_file.description: Optional absolute path to a compatible saved partial scan to resume.

name: participants_file_markers_build
description: Generate participant scene candidates from saved scan events without rescanning media. Poll file_job_status_read and fetch the JSON with file_job_result_read.

operation_id.description: A fresh UUID for each distinct file job. Reuse it when retrying the same request in this session.

analysis_file.description: Absolute path to the scan JSON.

rule.description: Optional ParticipantMarkerRule. Defaults to any participant change.

name: participants_file_project_inspect
description: Read the portable participant roster, accepted geometry, overrides and render plan of a saved project. Poll file_job_status_read and fetch the JSON with file_job_result_read.

operation_id.description: A fresh UUID for each distinct file job. Reuse it when retrying the same request in this session.

project_path.description: Absolute path to an existing .cut project.

name: participants_file_project_accept
description: Import a saved participant scan into a specific project recording. Verify and correct the accepted associations before rendering. Poll file_job_status_read and fetch the JSON with file_job_result_read.

operation_id.description: A fresh UUID for each distinct file job. Reuse it when retrying the same request in this session.

project_path.description: Absolute path to an existing .cut project.

source_id.description: Multicam recording ID or a sequence source path from the project.

analysis_file.description: Absolute path to the scan JSON.

out_project.description: Absolute path for a new .cut project.

in_place.description: Replace the project using its current disk revision.

name: participants_file_project_apply
description: Replace the accepted participant edit of a saved project. Use project inspect to retrieve the editable participant document. Poll file_job_status_read and fetch the JSON with file_job_result_read.

operation_id.description: A fresh UUID for each distinct file job. Reuse it when retrying the same request in this session.

project_path.description: Absolute path to an existing .cut project.

participants.description: The complete ParticipantProject object returned by participants_file_project_inspect.

participants_file.description: Absolute path to a saved participant object. Use this for edits larger than a tool request.

out_project.description: Absolute path for a new .cut project.

in_place.description: Replace the project using its current disk revision.

name: participants_file_render_plan
description: Report the shot canvas, duration, audio and coverage for a participant render. Poll file_job_status_read and fetch the JSON with file_job_result_read.

operation_id.description: A fresh UUID for each distinct file job. Reuse it when retrying the same request in this session.

project_path.description: Absolute path to an existing .cut project.

plan.description: Optional ParticipantRenderPlan. Omit this to use the saved participant plan.

output.description: Optional absolute output path to check without writing a movie.

name: participants_file_render_export
description: Render participant shots to a new movie. Unresolved privacy intervals follow the plan’s explicit stop or full-frame cover policy. Poll file_job_status_read and fetch the JSON with file_job_result_read.

operation_id.description: A fresh UUID for each distinct file job. Reuse it when retrying the same request in this session.

project_path.description: Absolute path to an existing .cut project.

plan.description: Optional ParticipantRenderPlan. Omit this to use the saved participant plan.

output.description: Absolute path for a new movie.

name: participants_file_angles_list
description: Plan virtual angles for selected participants on a common source clock. Poll file_job_status_read and fetch the JSON with file_job_result_read.

operation_id.description: A fresh UUID for each distinct file job. Reuse it when retrying the same request in this session.

project_path.description: Absolute path to an existing .cut project.

source_id.description: Multicam recording ID or a sequence source path from the project.

from.description: Exact rational seconds in the source clock.

to.description: Exact rational seconds in the source clock.

name: participants_file_angles_plan
description: Report picture coverage, duration and audio routing before rendering aligned angle media. Poll file_job_status_read and fetch the JSON with file_job_result_read.

operation_id.description: A fresh UUID for each distinct file job. Reuse it when retrying the same request in this session.

project_path.description: Absolute path to an existing .cut project.

source_id.description: Multicam recording ID or a sequence source path from the project.

from.description: Exact rational seconds in the source clock.

to.description: Exact rational seconds in the source clock.

canvas.description: ParticipantCanvas with dimensions, frame rate and RGB background.

audio.description: Optional ParticipantMulticamAudioRouting. Defaults to one gallery mix lane.

name: participants_file_angles_render
description: Write aligned participant angle movies and multicam.cut to a new directory. Poll file_job_status_read and fetch the JSON with file_job_result_read.

operation_id.description: A fresh UUID for each distinct file job. Reuse it when retrying the same request in this session.

project_path.description: Absolute path to an existing .cut project.

source_id.description: Multicam recording ID or a sequence source path from the project.

from.description: Exact rational seconds in the source clock.

to.description: Exact rational seconds in the source clock.

canvas.description: ParticipantCanvas with dimensions, frame rate and RGB background.

audio.description: Optional ParticipantMulticamAudioRouting. Defaults to one gallery mix lane.

output_directory.description: Absolute path of a new directory for the angle movies and project.
